γαββαθα.def: Gabbatha, a sort of paved square, on which the procurator had his judgment seat.

γαβριηλ.def: the angel Gabriel, a messenger of God.

γαδ.def: Gad, one of the twelve tribes of Israel.

γαδαρηνοσ.def: Gadarene, belonging to Gadara (an important Hellenized town, one of the Decapolis, and south-east of the Sea of Galilee).

γαζα.def: Gaza, an old town in the south of Palestine, on the sea-coast.

γαιοσ.def: Gaius, (a) a Corinthian, (b) a Macedonian, (c) a citizen of Derbe, (d) an Ephesian.

γαλατησ.def: a Galatian (meaning any inhabitant of the Roman province Galatia).

γαλατια.def: Galatia, a large Roman province in central Asia Minor, comprising the districts of Paphlagonia, Pontus Galaticus, Galatia (in the narrower sense, which some still think is intended in the NT), Phrygia Galatica, Lycaonia Galatica, Pisidia and Isaurica.

γαλατικοσ.def: Galatic, belonging to the province Galatia.

γαλιλαια.def: Galilee, a district towards the southern end of the Roman province Syria; the northern division of Palestine.

γαλιλαιοσ.def: a Galilean, an inhabitant of Galilee.

γαλλιων.def: Gallio, Lucius Iunius Gallio, who received this name by adoption into another family, but was born brother of the philosopher Seneca and originally named L. Annaeus Nouatus; proconsul of the Roman province Achaia from spring A.D. 52 to spring 53.

γαμαλιηλ.def: Gamaliel, a noted Pharisee, teacher of Saul.

γαμεω.def: I marry, used of either sex.

γαμοσ.def: a marriage, wedding, wedding-ceremony; plur: a wedding-feast.

γαστηρ.gloss: the womb, stomach, to be pregnant
γαστηρ.def: the womb, stomach; of a woman: to be with child (lit: to have [a child] in the belly).

γε.def: an enclitic, emphasizing particle: at least, indeed, really, but generally too subtle to be represented in English.

γεδεων.def: Gideon, one of the Judges of Israel.

γεεννα.def: Gehenna, and originally the name of a valley or cavity near Jerusalem, a place underneath the earth, a place of punishment for evil.

γεθσημανη.def: Gethsemane, a small place between the brook Kidron and the Mount of Olives near Jerusalem.

γενεα.def: a generation; if repeated twice or with another time word, practically indicates infinity of time.

γενεαλογεω.gloss: I put into a genealogy, reckon my descent
γενεαλογεω.def: I put into a genealogy, reckon my descent.

γενναω.gloss: I beget, bring forth, give birth to
γενναω.def: I beget (of the male), (of the female) I bring forth, give birth to.

γεννησαρετ.def: Gennesaret, a fertile district by the lake of Tiberias, which was in consequence sometimes called the Lake of Gennesaret.

γερουσια.def: the assembly or body of elders.

γεωργεω.gloss: I work the soil, cultivate the earth
γεωργεω.def: I work the soil, cultivate the earth.

γεωργοσ.gloss: a worker of the soil, husbandman, vine-dresser
γεωργοσ.def: a worker of the soil, husbandman, farmer, farm-laborer, vine-dresser.

γη.def: the earth, soil, land, region, country, inhabitants of a region.

γινομαι.gloss: I come into being, am born
γινομαι.def: I come into being, am born, become, come about, happen.

γινωσκω.gloss: I come to know, learn, realize
γινωσκω.def: I am taking in knowledge, come to know, learn; aor: I ascertained, realized.

γλευκοσ.def: the unfermented juice of grapes; hence: sweet new wine.

γλωσσα.def: the tongue, a language, a nation (usually distinguished by their speech).

γλωσσοκομον.def: (a vernacular word), bag, purse; some prefer to take as: box, chest.

γνησιοσ.def: (lit: born in wedlock), hence: real, true, genuine; with definite article: the true, genuine element.

γνωριζω.def: I make known, declare, know, discover.

γογγυζω.def: I whisper, murmur, grumble (generally of smoldering discontent).

γοησ.def: a conjuror, juggler, sorcerer; a tricky (crafty) deceiver, imposter.

γολγοθα.def: Golgotha, a knoll outside the wall of Jerusalem.

γομορρα.def: Gomorrah, one of the destroyed cities on the Dead Sea.

γονυπετεω.gloss: I fall on my knees before, supplicate, entreat
γονυπετεω.def: I fall on my knees before (in supplication), supplicate, entreat.

γραμμα.def: a letter of the alphabet; collectively: written (revelation); (a) a written document, a letter, an epistle, (b) writings, literature, learning.

γραμματευσ.gloss: a scribe, town-clerk, man of learning
γραμματευσ.def: (a) in Jerusalem, a scribe, one learned in the Jewish Law, a religious teacher, (b) at Ephesus, the town-clerk, the secretary of the city, (c) a man of learning generally.

γραφη.gloss: a writing, passage of scripture, the scriptures
γραφη.def: (a) a writing, (b) a passage of scripture; plur: the scriptures.

γραφω.def: I write; pass: it is written, it stands written (in the scriptures).

γραωδησ.gloss: belonging to old women, such as old women tell
γραωδησ.def: belonging to old women, such as old women tell.

γρηγορεω.gloss: I am awake, am vigilant, watch
γρηγορεω.def: (a) I am awake (in the night), watch, (b) I am watchful, on the alert, vigilant.

γυμναζω.def: I train by physical exercise; hence: train, in the widest sense.

γυμνητευω.def: I am poorly clad; I am habitually wearing an under-garment only.

γυμνοσ.def: rarely: stark-naked; generally: wearing only the under-garment; bare, open, manifest; mere.

γυναικαριον.gloss: a woman, a poor weak woman
γυναικαριον.def: a woman, with all a woman's weakness, a poor weak woman, a silly woman.

γυναικειοσ.def: belonging to woman, of woman, female.

γωγ.def: Gog, in Ezekiel a king of Magog, a land of the remote north; hence, in Revelation, of a people far remote from Palestine.

γωνια.def: a corner; met: a secret place.
